title: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Far East District (FED), 2026 FED Industry Day
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY.US ARMY CORPS OF ENGINEERS
detail_text: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, 2026 FED Industry Day The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Far East District (FED), invites interested parties to participate in the 2026 FED Industry Day in collaboration with the Public Procurement Service (PPS), Republic of Korea. This event will provide industry partners an opportunity to network with Government personnel and other contractors (large and small, U.S. and local companies), and to learn about upcoming business opportunities with USACE-FED. Date/Time: Tuesday, 7 April 2026, 09:00 AM – 16:00 PM (Korea Standard Time) Location: Lake Park Ballroom, Courtyard by Marriott, Suwon 320, Gwanggyohosugongwon-ro, Yeongtong-gu, Suwon-si, Gyeonggi-so, 16514, Republic of Korea Purpose The purpose of this Industry Day is to provide industry partners with: An overview of USACE FED programs and mission requirements Information on potential upcoming contracting opportunities Guidance on contracting requirements and compliance Opportunities to engage with Government representatives and industry participants Who Should Attend This event is open to all industries, including but not limited to: Construction Architecture & Engineering Supplies & Services Other related sectors Tentative Agenda 09:00 – 10:00: FED Industry Day & PPS Introduction: Program Overview and Potential Workload 10:00 – 12:00: Contracting Requirement (Updated CMMC Implementation, Safety requirement and SOFA Compliance) with Q&A Session 13:00 -16:00: Overview of FED construction project with Q&A Session Note: The presentation will be conducted in English only. No translation services will be provided. Participation Attendance is limited to a maximum of three (3) individuals per company. RSVP Deadline: 23 March 2026, 12:00 KST. Please submit the following information via email to the points of contact listed below: Company Name Full Name(s) of Attendees (maximum three (3)) Title/Position of Each Attendee Points of Contact: Ms. Sonya Sharp – sonya.s.sharp@usace.army.mil Venue Information: For hotel accommodation inquiries related to the Industry Day, please contact Ms. Ella Cho directly at the Courtyard by Marriott Suwon.
